_comment: Curation map for convert-bbc-to-topics.mjs. Each entry defines ONE net-new app topic and the BBC scraped guides that serve as REFERENCE material for authoring it (BBC text is never published verbatim — see revised-implementation-plan.md Phase 1.5). 'subject' = tools/data dir; 'topicSlug' = BBC topic dir; optional 'guides' allowlist / 'excludeGuides' denylist filter guide slugs within the topic dir. Only add entries whose 'id' does NOT already exist in src/content/data/topics/ (existing topics win).

topics.title: Quadratic Graphs
topics.description: Plotting and interpreting graphs of quadratic functions — parabolas, roots, turning points and symmetry.

topics.title: Quadratic Expressions
topics.description: Expanding double brackets and factorising quadratic expressions — an introduction to quadratics.

topics.title: Standard Form (Deeper)
topics.description: Calculating with numbers in standard index form — multiplication, division, addition and subtraction without a calculator.

topics.title: Error Intervals & Bounds
topics.description: Upper and lower bounds of rounded values, error intervals and limits of accuracy in calculations.

topics.title: Surds
topics.description: Exact irrational values — simplifying surds and carrying out calculations with them.

topics.title: 3D Geometry (Trigonometry-Free)
topics.description: Volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, cones and spheres; plans and elevations of 3D shapes.

topics.title: Working Scientifically in Chemistry
topics.description: Variables, hypotheses, planning experiments, data types, graphs and evaluation — the practical skills of KS3 chemistry.

topics.title: Working Scientifically in Physics
topics.description: Variables, hypotheses, planning experiments, data types, graphs and evaluation — the practical skills of KS3 physics.

topics.title: Spelling Strategies
topics.description: Spelling rules, patterns and memory strategies — homophones, common confusions and proofreading for spelling.
